source.text: Gisteren dachten we weer te kunnen genieten van een lekker broodje gemuse kebab. We kwamen van een koude kermis thuis: de kebab zwom in een zee van saus. Het was misselijkmakend. Daar moesten we dan ook nog eens enorm lang op wachten.
source.textTranslated: Yesterday, we thought we would enjoy a tasty Gemuse kebab sandwich again. We were sorely disappointed: the kebab was swimming in a sea of ​​sauce. It was nauseating. On top of that, we had to wait an incredibly long time for it.

claims.text: they thought they would enjoy a tasty Gemuse kebab sandwich again
the kebab was swimming in a sea of sauce
they had to wait an incredibly long time

reference.notes: The 'again' and the disappointment hint at a worse-than-before visit, but the review states no earlier quality explicitly, so the disappointment is an opinion with change allowed as an alternative. Drowning in sauce is read as seasoning (oversauced), with taste as an alternative.
